_doc: Bridge conformance fixture — peak-load CellSnapshot (large bid/ask volumes, hundreds of trades, realistic price_bucket and recent ts_ms). The companion .msgpack file is the byte-level oracle: both sides (Rust rmp-serde + Bun msgpackr with useRecords:false) MUST produce and accept these exact bytes. Hand-edit this JSON to change the logical value, then regenerate the .msgpack via `cargo run --bin gen-fixtures` from projects/tape/worker/. NEVER hand-edit the .msgpack file. See ADR-003 § Consequences and projects/tape/server/README.md `Bridge conformance fixtures`.
